result.answer: The original v1 schedule lists the project review for Thursday at 09:30 local time. The current instruction supported by the records is Thursday at 10:00 local time: amendment v2 expressly says it moved the review to that time and replaces v1's time.

approaches.description: Read v1 as the original schedule and v2 as the later superseding instruction, using v2's explicit replacement language.
approaches.reason: The supplied amendment explicitly identifies both the new time and its replacement of v1's time.

claims.basis_reference: schedule-original states the v1 meeting time.
claims.statement: The original v1 schedule records Thursday at 09:30 local time.

claims.basis_reference: schedule-amendment states the new time and that it replaces v1's time.

citations.quote: This amendment replaces the time in v1.

claims.statement: Amendment v2 records Thursday at 10:00 local time and states that it replaces v1's time.

claims.basis_reference: Derived by applying the amendment's explicit replacement statement to the two recorded times.
claims.statement: The current meeting time supported by these records is Thursday at 10:00 local time; Thursday at 09:30 local time is the original, superseded v1 time.

proof_steps.justification: This is the time stated in the supplied v1 record.
proof_steps.statement: Identify Thursday at 09:30 local time as the v1 meeting time.

proof_steps.justification: This is the time stated in the supplied v2 amendment.
proof_steps.statement: Identify Thursday at 10:00 local time as the v2 meeting time.

proof_steps.justification: The amendment expressly directs that its stated time replaces v1's time.
